prompt: In a pencil sketch with light color wash style, a cluttered car repair garage is depicted with fine graphite lines and subtle watercolor tints. A mechanic in blue overalls stands on the left, holding a heavy wrench while leaning against a red hydraulic lift. Next to him, a silver sedan rests elevated, its hood open to reveal a detailed engine block. On the right, an apprentice in a gray shirt points at a hanging toolbox filled with screwdrivers and pliers. A black oil can sits on the workbench in the foreground, next to a ragged white cloth. A brown dog sleeps peacefully under the car near the rear tire. Above, fluorescent lights cast soft shadows across the concrete floor. In the center, a customer in a beige coat looks at a clipboard held by the manager, who wears glasses and a dark suit. A yellow warning sign leans against a stack of tires in the background. The scene captures the interaction of pointing, holding, looking, leaning, and resting within the industrial space. Soft gray washes define the depth of the garage walls, while faint blue tones highlight the metallic surfaces of the tools and vehicle parts scattered around the busy workspace.
